name: helios-office
description: Helios Office intranet and HRM platform for a 200-person organization.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run start:worker:dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test:e2e -w apps/api
